subject: Clearance calendar: final go/no-go + signature windows
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clearance calendar: final go/no-go + signature windows

Team — putting a concise plan on your radar for Starlite close. We need to lock the approval calendar and signer ownership so legal/procurement can route the docs without delays. Key asks below and a proposed timeline.

What we need from each owner by EOD Jul 3:
- Legal (Laura): confirm redlines accepted or list of mandatory items to escalate; final SOW version by Jul 3 17:00 PT.
- Sales Ops (Ben): confirm DocuSign routing order and internal approver emails; prepare discount/credit memo if required.
- Solutions (Camila): confirm activation dependencies and pilot gating criteria; identify any tech holdouts that would push start date.

Proposed high-level schedule (subject to Laura's redlines):
- Jul 3 (EOD): final SOW + MAP agreed
- Jul 7: procurement sends PO / countersign doc readiness
- Jul 9: dedicated executive signature window (08:00–17:00 PT) via DocuSign
- Jul 10: limited pilot activation (read-only / eval cluster)
- Jul 14: production start date (full capacity)

Attachments: Starlite_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v3.xlsx (working MAP), SOW_Starlite_Redwood_v2.pdf

Routing notes: I propose DocuSign recipient order: Starlite legal -> Starlite exec (Elaine) -> Redwood legal (Laura) -> Redwood exec (Karthik). Ben, confirm if we should add a procurement recipient for PO acknowledgement.

If we can confirm the above by Jul 3 EOD, we have a clean runway for a Jul 9 signing and Jul 14 start. If not, we should surface any blockers and propose alternate windows.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Ng <elaine@starlite.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@starlite.io
Date: 2025-07-01T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clearance calendar: final go/no-go + signature windows

Thanks, Karthik — appreciate the clear timeline. Quick notes from our side: 

- Legal: we'll aim to turn the SOW back quickly but need the SSO appendix included before countersign. If Redwood can include the SSO paragraph in your SOW v2, our counsel may be able to finish review by Jul 3.
- Procurement: PO issuance target is Jul 7 but depends on final price table and the credit memo (if any). I'll nudge them today.
- Evaluation acceptance: before full start we need to validate three acceptance criteria (latency under 300ms 95th, embeddings similarity > 0.86 on our testset, and no PII logging). Can you confirm these are captured in the MAP?

We are open to a limited pilot earlier (Jul 10 suggested) if we have a countersigned minimal SOW + data handling addendum. Please confirm the minimal set of docs needed to start the eval cluster.

Cheers,
Elaine Ng
Director, Platform Engineering | Starlite Retail

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-01T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clearance calendar: final go/no-go + signature windows

Adding the operational detail and owners for the MAP — attaching v3. Short answers to Elaine's asks inline below.

- Acceptance criteria: listed and owner-assigned in MAP tab "Eval Criteria". TL;DR: latency target is documented (95th < 300ms) and embedding score threshold is included. PII: we will enforce KV cache redaction and customer-controlled retention; see data handling addendum placeholder.
- Minimal documents to start pilot: countersigned SOW (core terms + data handling addendum) OR SOW + express Letter to allow read-only eval cluster. We don't need full PO to spin up eval, but we do need countersign or exec email approval documenting acceptance of pilot terms.
- Pilot scope Jul 10: read-only queries, rate-limited to 50 rps, no access to production datasets. Full GA Jul 14 contingent on PO and clearance.

Proposed MAP milestones (owners):
- SOW redlines complete (Laura) — due Jul 3 17:00 PT
- Data addendum drafted (Camila) — due Jul 2 12:00 PT
- Internal exec signoff (Karthik) — Jul 9 window
- Procurement PO received (Starlite procurement) — Jul 7
- Infrastructure ready for pilot (Camila infra team) — Jul 9 evening

DocuSign routing: I recommend a parallel route for legal countersignatures to avoid serial delays: Starlite legal + exec in parallel, then Redwood legal + exec in parallel, with procurement copy. Ben — can you create the routing stub (Signature_Route_DocuSign.txt) and confirm recipient emails?

Quoted for context: 
> On Jul 1, 2025, Elaine Ng <elaine@starlite.io> wrote:
> Thanks, Karthik — appreciate the clear timeline. Quick notes from our side...

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Ng <elaine@starlite.io>, procurement@starlite.io
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, DocuSign Notifications <no-reply@docusign.net>
Date: 2025-07-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clearance calendar: final go/no-go + signature windows

Elaine / procurement — confirming the final cadence so both teams can lock calendars and send necessary artifacts. Please confirm acceptance by Jul 3 EOD so we can hit the signing windows below.

Final agreed timeline (status: pending your confirmation):
- Jul 2 (today): Redwood posts data addendum draft (attached in MAP v3)
- Jul 3 EOD: Starlite to confirm SOW redlines (Laura and Starlite legal)
- Jul 7: Procurement sends PO (or formal email acknowledgement referencing DEAL-3821)
- Jul 9, 08:00–17:00 PT: Executive signing window (DocuSign) — please keep this day clear for rapid countersignatures
- Jul 10: Limited pilot activation (read-only) — tech checklist must be green by Jul 9 20:00 PT
- Jul 14: Production start (full capacity)

Attachments: Starlite_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v3.xlsx, SOW_Starlite_Redwood_v2.pdf, Signature_Route_DocuSign.txt

Open items for Starlite:
- Confirm SSO appendix inclusion (Elaine)
- Confirm procurement PO timeline (procurement@starlite.io)
- Confirm acceptance criteria in MAP (Elaine)

If you confirm the SOW redlines and acceptance criteria by Jul 3 EOD, I'll proceed to create the DocuSign envelope and route per the Signature_Route_DocuSign.txt ordering.

Thanks and looking forward —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
